summary:
Implementation plan for Digital Dark Spot:
- Added real-time search bar to DashboardView filtering research projects by title, research questions, and extracted topics
- Implemented persistent embedded server database storage (SQLite / persistent JSON file system) for all research projects, sources, and findings
- Removed "Hackathon 2026" navigation pill badge
- Removed "Judge and CSE Guide" button, modal component, and all associated competition artifacts
- Maintained clean SaaS dashboard visual hierarchy, tabular metrics, and SSRF security guards
